familySetupBody: To get started, create a group for your family or join one with the code someone shared with you.
familySetupWhatTitle: What is a family in Nexo?
familySetupWhatGroup: A private group of up to {max} adults who look out for each other.
familySetupWhatConsent: Each person decides whether to share their location with the group and can pause it at any time.
familySetupWhatInvite: Only people who receive an invitation code from someone who manages the group can join.
familyCreateBody: Give it a name everyone will recognize. You can invite the others afterwards.
familyCreateOwnerNote: You will manage the group: you can invite and remove members.
familyJoinBody: Enter the code shared with you by someone who manages the family.
familyJoinPrivacyNote: Once you join, you'll see the location of the people who share it in that family. Yours is only shared if you turn it on.
familyErrorNameRequired: Enter a name for the family.
familyErrorNameInvalid: That name isn't valid. Use 1 to {max} characters, with at least one letter or number.
familyErrorTooManyFamilies: You already belong to the maximum number of families. To create another one, leave one first.
familyErrorInvitationFormat: Check the code: it has 10 letters and numbers, like ABCDE-FGHJK.
familyErrorInvitationInvalid: The code isn't valid or has expired. Ask the person who invited you for a new one.
familyErrorAlreadyMember: You already belong to this family.
familyErrorFamilyFull: This family already has {max} members, the maximum allowed.
familyErrorRateLimited: Too many attempts. For your security, wait a while before trying again.
familyErrorNotAllowedInvite: Only people who manage the group can invite others.
familyErrorTooManyInvitations: This group already has too many active invitations. Wait until they're used or expire.
familyErrorNotAllowedRemove: You don't have permission to remove this person from the group.
familyErrorNotMember: This person is no longer in the group.
familyPrivacyNote: Each person decides whether to share their location. Nobody can turn it on for someone else.
familyLeaveSee: You'll stop seeing this group's locations and activity.
familyLeaveShare: You'll stop sharing your location with the group, and the last one you posted here will be deleted.
familyLeaveOwner: Since you manage the group, the longest-standing member will take over.
familyLeaveLast: You're the only person in the group, so the group will be deleted.
familyLeaveReturn: To come back, you'll need a new invitation.
familyEmptyBody: They'll appear here once the group syncs.
familyNoActiveTitle: You don't have an active family
familyInviteBody: Generate a code so someone can join {name}.
familyInviteExpiresHours: {hours, plural, =1{Expires in 1 h} other{Expires in {hours} h}}
familyInviteExpiresMinutes: {minutes, plural, =1{Expires in 1 min} other{Expires in {minutes} min}}
familyInviteExpired: This code has expired. Generate a new one.
familyInviteWarningShare: Share it only with the person you want to invite.
familyInviteWarningVisibility: Whoever joins will be able to see the location of the people who share it in this family.
familyInviteWarningOnce: For security, this code is only shown now. If you lose it, generate another one.
familyInviteFull: The group already has {max} members, the maximum allowed. Nobody else can join.
familyLocationDeviceNote: The location is reported by the device and may not be exact.
familyLocationUnavailable: We couldn't check the location status.
familyRemoveBody: {name} will stop seeing the group's locations and activity, and the location they shared here will be deleted. To come back, they'll need a new invitation.
familyRemoved: {name} is no longer in the group.
